bug_semantics: js_typed_array_constructor snapshots offset/len from an existing ArrayBuffer, then calls js_create_from_ctor, which does JS_GetProperty(new_target, prototype) and can run a getter. That getter can shrink a still-attached resizable ArrayBuffer via ArrayBuffer.prototype.resize (js_realloc to max(new_len,1)). typed_array_init then installs the view with the stale len and p->u.array.u.ptr = abuf->data + offset without re-checking detached/byte_length, so later element access (e.g. join/toString) heap-overflows the realloc'd buffer. Public PoC: Reflect.construct(Uint8Array, [new ArrayBuffer(10,{maxByteLength:10})], boundFnWhosePrototypeGetterCallsAb.resize()).
flaw_origin: The heap-overflow mechanism was first written in PR #646 member 878647e21dec1a101a5d7ced6134e70a8e2ffca8 (Add resizable ArrayBuffers): that commit introduced ArrayBuffer.prototype.resize and wired track_rab into js_typed_array_constructor, then called typed_array_init with the pre-ctor snapshot. In the same commit DataView was revalidated after js_create_from_ctor with an explicit comment that a RAB could have been resized there; the TypedArray constructor omitted the analogous check. Parent e569f39bf18b4670dd526b11ea09cd00d7be3e91 has no track_rab/resize/max_byte_length. Pre-RAB, ArrayBuffer length was immutable except detach (NULL data), which is not this realloc heap overflow.

reasoning: CVE-2026-0821/GHSA-rcpp-qhfh-r47v is a published, unwithdrawn heap-buffer-overflow in js_typed_array_constructor, confirmed by issue #1296, ASAN, and merged PR #1299. The attack is a constructor TOCTOU: snapshot buffer geometry, run js_create_from_ctor (prototype getter), then typed_array_init with stale offset/len against a RAB that resize() has already realloc'd smaller. The smallest first-write of that exploitable mechanism is PR #646 member 878647e (parent e569f39, verified missing RAB symbols). Mainline squash 37fe427 is a GitHub squash aggregate of five public members; later members do not rewrite the TA constructor, so they are recorded in decomposed_shas but are not the BIC. The same commit correctly revalidated DataView after js_create_from_ctor and missed TypedArray, which is why this sink existed from RAB introduction until c5d8083. Pre-RAB detach/transfer can neuter data to NULL but cannot produce this realloc heap overflow. AI is judged only on 878647e: human Ben Noordhuis author/committer, no commit-object AI markers, therefore NOT_AI. Fix SHA is the advisory/mainline landing c5d8083, first tagged in v0.12.0.
